summary: Square, icon-only button for frequent, recognizable actions (close, edit, settings).
whenToUse: Toolbars, card headers and table rows with little space.
whenNotToUse: Ambiguous or rare actions: prefer Button with text.
On/off states: use Toggle with an icon and aria-label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon, hidden from assistive technologies.

props.name: size
props.description: Side of the square, equal to the control height.

inherits: All Button props except children, startIcon, endIcon and fullWidth.
accessibility: The accessible name comes from label: TypeScript makes it required.
For sighted users, if the icon is not obvious, add a Tooltip with the same text.
The minimum side is 24 px even in compact density (WCAG 2.5.8).
responsive: Stable size: it does not stretch in flexible containers (flex: none).
commonMistakes: Passing visible text as children: use Button.
Using generic labels such as “Button” or “Icon”.
